_comment: Showcase recording of the DevOps Pipeline (sfdx-hardis-pipeline-view.gif): one Pull Request of the MyCompany-CRM universe, from review to deployed, with its deployment actions. The recording test adds it to the base fixtures in temporary files, in three states (open, merged with its deployment running, deployed). The GitHub stills of the github folder are taken by scripts/capture-github-merge.js.

pullRequest.title: CRM-1070 Agentforce case triage agent
pullRequest.description:
A Case Triage agent reads every new case, finds its category and sends it to the right queue.

- New agent `Case_Triage_Agent` and its permission set
- `CaseTriageService` can be called by the agent

Agentforce must be activated before the deployment, and the agent after it: both are declared as deployment actions.
